builds.name: Reference: AP dive
builds.goal: Reference for Sylas: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A spell-and-attack melee skirmisher who cycles empowered attacks and healing, adapting his ultimate options to enemy champions. Measure empowered passive attacks and W healing with a specified stolen R. Do not average every enemy ultimate into one guaranteed burst/utility result. AP, penetration and Rocketbelt access test a short committed damage window.
testPlan: Kit question for Sylas: Measure empowered passive attacks and W healing with a specified stolen R. Do not average every enemy ultimate into one guaranteed burst/utility result.

Start with the early core (Rocketbelt, then Shadowflame) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: AP, penetration and Rocketbelt access test a short committed damage window. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Sylas lashes his chains out, intersecting at his targeted location dealing damage to and slowing enemies. 

After a delay, magical energy explodes from the intersection point dealing damage. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: The active cannot replace every mobility tool; minimal sustained durability.
The route fails Sylas's stated kit question: Measure empowered passive attacks and W healing with a specified stolen R. Do not average every enemy ultimate into one guaranteed burst/utility result.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: The active cannot replace every mobility tool; minimal sustained durability.
Full cost 16,700 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Rocketbelt, then Shadowflame. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Zhonya's Hourglass are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

kitEvidence.formula:
After using an Ability, Sylas gains a charge (max [rankTable[2, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3]] charges). Sylas' Attacks expend a charge to whirl his chains, dealing [(1.3) × AD + (0.3) × AP] magic damage to the main target and [(0.4) × AD + (0.2) × AP] magic damage to other surrounding enemies.

While he has at least one charge, Sylas gains [125]% Attack Speed.

Sylas lunges at an enemy with magical force dealing [75 / 110 / 145 / 180 / 215 + (0.6) × AP] magic damage. Against champions, Sylas restores between [20 / 40 / 60 / 80 / 100 + (0.3) × AP + (0.05) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] and [(20 / 40 / 60 / 80 / 100 + (0.3) × AP + (0.05) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]) × (2)] Health based on his missing Health (max healing at or below [40]% Health).

Sylas hijacks an enemy champion, allowing him to cast a copy of their ultimate Ability, based on his Ultimate level and using his stats.

Hijacking an enemy places a Cooldown on them for [(runtimeCooldownMultiplier) × (200)]% (modified by Sylas' Ability Haste) of the enemy's ultimate's Cooldown, with a minimum of [40] seconds, during which time Sylas cannot hijack them again.

Sylas lashes his chains out, dealing [40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage and Slowing by [0.15 / 0.2 / 0.25 / 0.3 / 0.35] for [1.5] seconds. The place where the chains intersect explodes, dealing a further [60 / 115 / 170 / 225 / 280 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage.

Sylas quickly dashes, and prepares a Recast for 3.5 seconds.

Recast: Sylas throws his chains, pulling himself to the first enemy hit, dealing [80 / 130 / 180 / 230 / 280 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage, and Knocking Up for [0.5] seconds.
